Synopsis:
    JPMorgan cut its lending relationship with AI-focused hedge fund Situational Awareness, founded by ex-OpenAI researcher Leopold Aschenbrenner, following near-catastrophic losses stemming from leveraged bets on AI/chip stocks. A July chip-stock selloff triggered a margin call, wiping 67% of portfolio value. The fund liquidated most public equity holdings to Citadel. The SEC has since issued subpoenas to Wall Street banks to investigate the fund's trades and leverage usage.
